name: Living Metal
source:
At the edge of the universe, you interrogate Cass, a decommissioned android gone rogue. She killed to protect her friend – and consumed the bodies to repair herself. The truth of her past is waiting to be uncovered.

[From [url=https://feraldragongames.itch.io/living-metal]Itch.io[/url]]
